from pathlib import Path
import sys,json,hashlib,tempfile
root=Path.cwd()
sys.path.insert(0,str(root/'governance/compat'))
import check_active_session_state as authority
import run_agent_commit_steward_preflight as steward
results=[]
def record(name,expected,observed):
    results.append({'case':name,'expected':expected,'observed':observed,'pass':expected==observed})
with tempfile.TemporaryDirectory(prefix='cvf-local-range-') as dirname:
    fixture=Path(dirname)
    before=(authority.REPO_ROOT,steward.REPO_ROOT)
    authority.REPO_ROOT=fixture
    steward.REPO_ROOT=fixture
    try:
        bp='docs/baselines/local-fixture.md'; wp='docs/work_orders/local-fixture.md'
        for path in (bp,wp):
            p=fixture/path;p.parent.mkdir(parents=True,exist_ok=True);p.write_bytes(b'Status: ACTIVE\n')
        def digest(path):return hashlib.sha256((fixture/path).read_bytes()).hexdigest()
        pin={'baselinePath':bp,'baselineSha256':digest(bp),'workOrderPath':wp,'workOrderSha256':digest(wp)}
        record('pinned_active_pair',[],authority._validate_current_authority(pin))
        (fixture/wp).write_bytes(b'Status: CLOSED_PASS_BOUNDED\n')
        record('work_order_only_edit_stales_pin',True,any('workOrderSha256 does not match' in s for s in authority._validate_current_authority(pin)))
        (fixture/bp).write_bytes(b'Status: CLOSED_PASS_BOUNDED\n')
        record('both_edits_without_pin_update',2,len(authority._validate_current_authority(pin)))
        pin['workOrderSha256']=digest(wp);pin['baselineSha256']=digest(bp)
        record('frozen_pair_and_refreshed_pins',[],authority._validate_current_authority(pin))
        (fixture/wp).write_bytes(b'Status: CLOSED_PASS_BOUNDED\r\n')
        record('line_endings_are_raw_byte_identity',True,any('workOrderSha256 does not match' in s for s in authority._validate_current_authority(pin)))
        host='docs/reviews/local-closure.md'; paths=(host,bp,wp,'CVF_SESSION/state/ACTIVE_SESSION_STATE_CORE.json')
        p=fixture/host;p.parent.mkdir(parents=True,exist_ok=True)
        def text(manifest):
            return '## Agent Operation Trace Block\nActual changed set\n\n## Mixed Protected-Path Atomicity Authorization\nDisposition: AUTHORIZED_EXACT_MANIFEST\nAtomicity reason: fixed active pair raw hashes.\nRollback boundary: disposable fixture.\nExact changed manifest: '+'; '.join('`'+s+'`' for s in manifest)+'\n'
        p.write_text('## Agent Operation Trace Block\nActual changed set\n',encoding='utf-8')
        record('missing_exact_authorization',False,steward._has_exact_mixed_atomicity_authorization(host,paths))
        p.write_text(text(paths),encoding='utf-8')
        record('exact_authorization',True,steward._has_exact_mixed_atomicity_authorization(host,paths))
        p.write_text(text(paths[:-1]),encoding='utf-8')
        record('omitted_hash_source_path',False,steward._has_exact_mixed_atomicity_authorization(host,paths))
        p.write_text(text(paths),encoding='utf-8')
        record('additional_unlisted_changed_path',False,steward._has_exact_mixed_atomicity_authorization(host,paths+('unrelated.txt',)))
    finally:
        authority.REPO_ROOT,steward.REPO_ROOT=before
